title: kit.forms-config.v1
description: The `forms` block of a project's comms config (docs/FORMS.md): which forms the project declares and who owns them. Every declared form produces exactly two deliveries through the comms engine (POST /v1/comms/submit): the submitter's receipt (the form's acknowledgement template) and the owner's notification (the owner template, with the submission, the form id, the site and a link to the ledger row). The owner's recipients are never in git: `owner.secret` names the comms-engine Worker secret that holds them, and the deploy refuses to ship an engine that lacks it (kit comms secrets). A config with templates and no `forms.owner` is refused when the specs are built, so a project cannot declare a form whose owner hears nothing.

template.description: The key of the ops notification (ops[].key) that tells the owner of a submission.

secret.description: The comms-engine Worker secret that holds the owner's address (whose value is `address`). The one name the kit knows: the canon class form-bypasses-comms-submit refuses a read of it outside the engine, and its set `owner-secret-names` is held equal to this enum by a test, so a name cannot be added here without the gate learning it. Set by the owner; its name, and its value when the deploy environment holds it, are checked at deploy.

address.description: The owner's address: the project's own info@<brand.domain> (owner, 2026-10-13: one address per project; info@ forwards to the owner by Email Routing). Any other address is refused when the specs are built; the deploy refuses an engine whose secret holds anything else (kit comms secrets); the engine refuses to send the owner's copy anywhere else.

declared.description: The form ids the project declares, each the key of its acknowledgement template (templates[].key). Default: every template key. A form id the engine is asked to deliver that is not declared is refused (undeclared_form) and nothing is sent.
